briefdescription.para: If a handle supports deferred call - continue with the processing and place the deferred value on the caller's stack.

simplesect.para: true iff the handle is an object that is allowed to be passed across service/container boundaries (an immutable, a service or an object that has all pass-through fields)

briefdescription.para: DeferredCallHandle represents a deferred action, such as a property access or a method call, which would place the result of that action on the corresponding frame's stack.

detaileddescription.para: Note: this handle cannot be allocated naturally and must be processed in a special way.
